name: 08608 · Trenton, NJ
findings: ZIP 08608 (Trenton) has 113 nonprofit organizations. 87 of them (77%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 82 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08608 (Trenton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
74% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08608 (Trenton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 95.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 82 organizations here; 67% of all organizations here have no identified type.
